questions.q: What problem does wrapping the pipeline in a FastAPI endpoint solve, per this lesson?
options: It makes the pipeline faster to run
It removes the need for an evaluation set
It replaces the need for a vector database
It makes a pipeline that was only callable as functions in a script reachable over HTTP by anyone else
questions.explain: The lesson frames the API layer as closing the gap between a working pipeline (still just functions in a script) and a service a reviewer or teammate can actually call.

questions.q: Which Docker & AI Deployment course lessons does this lesson point to directly for containerizing the assistant?
options: Autoscaling AI Workloads and Caching Strategies for AI Apps
Blue-Green Deployment for AI Apps and Rollback Strategies
Packaging a Python AI App and Environment Variables & Secrets in Containers
This lesson does not reference the Docker & AI Deployment course at all
questions.explain: The lesson names "Packaging a Python AI App" and "Environment Variables & Secrets in Containers" specifically, applying that course's material instead of re-teaching it from scratch.

questions.q: Why does the Dockerfile's `ENV ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=""` line NOT count as setting a real key?
options: Because it only documents that the container expects the variable; the real value must be passed at run time
Because Docker ignores all ENV instructions
Because ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not a real environment variable name
Because FastAPI overrides the value automatically
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit that the empty ENV line documents the required variable without baking a real secret into the image — the actual key is passed at run time via docker run -e or a platform secret manager.

questions.q: Which of these is explicitly listed as something the README should let a reviewer learn without running any code?
options: The student's personal contact information
A list of every library version installed globally on the student's machine
The exact dollar cost of every API call made during development
The project's evaluation numbers, before and after tuning
questions.explain: The lesson lists architecture, evaluation numbers (before/after tuning), tradeoffs/out-of-scope items, and how to run it as the four things a reviewer should learn from the README alone.

questions.q: What does this lesson say still matters for deployment at this project's small scale, even though autoscaling was ruled out of scope?
options: Nothing — small-scale deployments have no requirements at all
The container must build cleanly, never hardcode the API key, and survive a restart without losing its Qdrant collection
The project must be deployed to at least three different cloud providers simultaneously
The API must support at least 10,000 requests per second
questions.explain: The lesson names clean builds, never-hardcoded secrets, and surviving a restart without losing the Qdrant collection as what still matters, even without autoscaling or a load balancer.
